## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: Both scripts refuse worktree removal when ANY guard fires; refusal identifies which.
- DD2: Open-PR check 3-tier fallback enumerating main PR + sub-PRs.
- DD3: --force prints firing guard + PR URL.

## Implementation Notes

Create `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh` following the established library pattern (see plugins/dso/scripts/lib/pr-comment-lib.sh, ci-findings-normalize.sh).

**Exports**:
1. `_guard_protected_branch <branch>` — return 0 if branch is protected (`main`, `master`, `develop`, `release/*`), 1 otherwise. Print `GUARD: protected_branch <branch>` to stderr on fire.

2. `_guard_uncommitted_state <worktree-path>` — return 0 if uncommitted OR unpushed, 1 otherwise.
   - `git -C <worktree> status --porcelain` non-empty → uncommitted
   - `git -C <worktree> log @{u}..HEAD --oneline` non-empty → unpushed (handle no-upstream case as 'unpushed')
   - Print `GUARD: uncommitted_state <worktree>` on fire.

3. `_guard_open_pr_with_ci <branch> <sha>` — return 0 if any open PR found across 3-tier fallback, 1 if none.
   - Tier 1: `gh pr list --head "$branch" --state open --json number,url --jq '.'` (capture URLs into accumulator)
   - Tier 2: `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/$sha/pulls --jq '[.[]|select(.state=="open")]'` (capture URLs)
   - Tier 3: `gh pr list --search "head:$branch" --state open --json number,url --jq '.'`
   - Deduplicate by PR number across tiers. Print `GUARD: open_pr_with_ci <branch> PRs: <url1>, <url2>, ...` on fire.

4. `assert_worktree_removable <worktree> <branch> [--force]` — orchestrator. Runs all 3 guards (NOT short-circuit \xe2\x80\x94 collect all firing guards for DD#1 message). Behavior:
   - All guards clear: exit 0 silently.
   - At least one guard fires WITHOUT --force: print all firing guards' messages to stderr; exit 1.
   - At least one guard fires WITH --force: print all firing guards' messages to stderr; exit 0 (bypass).

**Library convention**:
- Source guard: `if [[ "\${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" != "\${0}" ]] || [[ "\${_GUARDS_SOURCE_ONLY:-0}" == "1" ]]; then ... fi`
- shellcheck-clean.
- See pr-comment-lib.sh for header style + function-export idiom.

After implementation: T1 must pass GREEN. Remove .test-index marker.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh` | create | `tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh` (RED in T1) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | remove marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Library exists at the expected path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] Shellcheck clean
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] All 4 functions defined
  Verify: grep -cE '_guard_protected_branch|_guard_uncommitted_state|_guard_open_pr_with_ci|assert_worktree_removable' plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh | awk '{exit (\$1>=4?0:1)}'
- [ ] T1 now passes GREEN
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] .test-index no longer carries the marker
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_worktree_removal_guards\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate to opus then user.
